{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

Some problems have fast algorithms; for others, the best known algorithms
take time that grows exponentially with the size of the input.
This page defines the class P of problems with fast algorithms,
and the class NP of problems whose yes answers can be checked fast,
measuring speed with [asymptotic notation](asymptotic-notation.qmd).
